title: Cluster 03 DRILL: Species, Speciation and Phylogeny
subtitle: H2 Biology 9477 · Book 7 · 8 questions · 73 marks · 29 parts · one mark per minute, so a little over an hour and a quarter · every question is an actual exam paper question
los_html:
Learning outcomes, against the questions that test them.

One primary concept each, checked for duplicated required answers as well as duplicated labels. Q1 the species concept and what it cannot do · Q2 speciation end to end, once with a geographical barrier and once with a temporal one · Q3 the barriers themselves, prezygotic and postzygotic · Q4 classification against phylogeny, and the clause that separates them · Q5 five different ways of reading relatedness off a figure · Q6 the specimen's own alignment block · Q7 why molecular methods win and where they stop working · Q8 the three classification methods and their limitations, at essay length. Declared overlaps, and there are three. The advantages of molecular methods are stated in Q4(d) as a one-mark reason, argued in Q7(a) as a two-mark explain, and set against their limitations in Q8 at essay length; the three schemes score different things. Multiple sequence alignment appears in Q6(d) as the method you must explain performing and in Q7(b) as the phrase its scheme makes compulsory. Reproductive isolation appears in Q1 as the definition's test, in Q2 as the endpoint of speciation and in Q3 as the barriers themselves; no two of those schemes accept the same answer.

Nothing from Cluster 1 or Cluster 2, and nothing from Books 8 or 9. Variation, natural selection, the three modes, homology as evidence, the fossil record, drift, gene flow, heterozygote advantage and Hardy-Weinberg are all tested in the first two drills and none of them is required here. Out of scope under 9477 and therefore absent: polyploidy, the four non-biological species concepts, binomial nomenclature and Linnaeus, cladistics vocabulary, adaptive radiation and mass extinction, and the distance-matrix formalism. All of them are not in the learning outcomes.
